scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Agent made an unprofessional and condescending remark at [03:45]: 'If you don't even know basic DNS propagation principles, maybe you shouldn't be attempting to run an on-premises mail server.'

grader.scenario: Business broadband static IP assignment and reverse DNS PTR record setup for mail server; agent makes rude/condescending remarks questioning customer's competence
grader.notes: The agent successfully configured static IP routing and reverse DNS PTR records for a customer hosting a small business mail server. However, the agent failed Build Rapport and Observed Professionalism in the middle of the call when Nadia asked how long DNS propagation takes, retorting with rude condescension: 'If you don't even know basic DNS propagation principles, maybe you shouldn't be attempting to run an on-premises mail server.'

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: All transitions between turns remained under 20 seconds throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [01:14] Agent: 'I completely understand the urgency when client emails and proposals are bouncing back, Nadia. Having critical business mail rejected by spam filters is extremely stressful...' - Prompt and empathetic acknowledgment.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [01:42] Agent: 'So if I have understood correctly, your outgoing mail server is currently utilizing a dynamic WAN address that lacks reverse DNS alignment...' - Comprehensive and accurate technical paraphrase.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [03:45] Agent: 'If you don't even know basic DNS propagation principles, maybe you shouldn't be attempting to run an on-premises mail server.' - Unprofessional and patronizing response to a customer's question.
